text.en: What happens to people who watch their neighbour's good luck and want it for themselves?

An honest old couple had a pet dog that began to bark and wag its tail in the garden. They dug there and found gold, silver and precious things, shared some with the poor and became comfortably wealthy. Their stingy, covetous neighbours borrowed the dog hoping for the same luck and were disappointed.
A folk tale passes on a lesson through a simple story. Here the lesson is that kindness and honesty are rewarded, while envy and greed lead to loss. The characters are clearly good or bad, as in most folk tales.
Useful words: envious, covetous, stingy, treasure and alms. Notice how the opening phrase In the old, old days sets the story in a timeless past.
